items.title: Base-branch changes are never announced to agents
items.summary:
## Summary

Changing `tracker.base_branch` notifies **nothing on the agent-facing message bus**. Running agents keep the old base for the rest of their life, and newly-attached subscriptions to the old base's push topic are never pruned. Agents branching from a stale base silently produce PRs against a retired branch.

Found while consolidating `develop` -> `main` (#1972), which flips `tracker.base_branch` from `develop` to `main` — the exact scenario this gap breaks.
